anchors.paper_title: Interrater reliability for sleep scoring according to the Rechtschaffen & Kales and the new AASM standard
anchors.reason: Paper reports interrater reliability of sleep scoring (AASM vs R&K) on the SIESTA database; it is a cited background reference, not a description of the BOAS dataset.

anchors.paper_title: The American Academy of Sleep Medicine Inter-scorer Reliability Program: Sleep Stage Scoring
anchors.reason: The AASM inter-scorer reliability program paper describes a sleep-scoring standard/protocol that the dataset's human sleep scoring relies on, not this dataset itself.

anchors.paper_title: Automatic sleep scoring for real-time monitoring and stimulation in individuals with and without sleep apnea
anchors.reason: Same group (Bitbrain, Sierra-Torralba, Klinzing) studies automatic sleep scoring CNNs using sleep datasets, but it is an algorithm study, not the BOAS data descriptor.

metadata.methods_description: Participants were recorded overnight with a Micromed PSG system (EEG, EOG, EMG, respiratory belts, thermistor, nasal cannula, PPG/SpO2) and simultaneously with a Bitbrain wearable headband (forehead EEG near AF7/AF8, IMU, PPG pulse). Three expert scorers independently staged PSG recordings per AASM criteria; consensus labels were taken by majority, with a fourth scorer resolving three-way disagreements. A deep learning model was trained with cross-validation on PSG and headband data to produce AI labels.
